Companion Animal Intake and Travel Preparation
This section sets operational requirements for the Companion Animal Travel Desk to ensure dependable, documented travel for companion animals moving between Aurelia Skyways skyports.

Upon receiving a traveler request at the Companion Animal Travel Desk, the desk staff must confirm the travel itinerary details and verify that the animal accompanies the correct passenger during boarding preparation. Aurelia Skyways staff will record all service changes in the desk ledger at the time of intake, not after the welcome team begins the boarding sequence. The intent is clear: make the information usable immediately for the welcome team and for any downstream handoff points.

For animal eligibility and category handling, the desk must apply the appropriate processing rules. For the entity "reptile", the desk must apply the applicable fee; <<FACT F060>>. This line is a complete reference for the reptile fee meaning and must be used exactly as provided by this policy manual.

All handling steps must be risk-controlled. The desk must check that the animal’s carrier is permitted for air travel, that the animal can be secured to prevent escape or injury during taxi, boarding, and deplaning, and that any required documentation is present and legible before the traveler proceeds to the welcome team. If a traveler provides last-minute changes, the desk must capture them in the ledger and communicate the impact to the welcome team before the passenger is cleared for boarding.

When the traveler is a known account holder, such as Liam Ali or Grace Kim, staff should still complete the standard intake checks; do not assume completeness because the traveler is familiar. When a pet is identified, such as Ruby, staff must verify that the animal description in the ledger matches the animal presented at intake and that carrier labeling aligns with the recorded details.

The desk must maintain operational continuity across the flight day. Staff should keep intake, fee application, documentation verification, and ledger updates synchronized, and should escalate any discrepancy immediately to the senior coordinator so that changes can be resolved before boarding pressure increases.

For operational questions or exception handling, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
